description: Headless video duplicate finder with a web UI, perceptual hashing, FFmpeg probing, and corruption detection. Designed for NAS and home-server libraries.
tagline: Find duplicate videos by content, not filename.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: VDFusion has no authentication. Keep it on a trusted LAN or behind a reverse proxy. The app is amd64-only.

title: VDFusion
